scope: Eight separate graph/observation contracts; conditional responses to version-specific published questions.

receivers.input_contract: Permanent source genders, finite roots/birth prefixes, parent coverage and child cap d.
receivers.result: Recorded avoidance existence iff d>=2 and target is not eventually periodic.
receivers.limit: Model translation and proof scope required; d<2 empty class, target-dependent witness, no minimal roots/finite recognizer.

receivers.input_contract: k>=2, nonempty avoider class, host child cap k and injective adjacency embeddings.
receivers.result: For each host a language-preserving padded avoider is nonembeddable.
receivers.limit: Host-dependent rival; extra roots/disconnected finite terminal components allowed, no countable-family claim.

receivers.input_contract: One actual avoider, countable locally finite hosts, injective finite-uniform-stretch maps.
receivers.result: Terminal-clone diagonal defeats all supplied hosts/stretch bounds.
receivers.limit: No balanced uniform child cap, terminal-free class or unbounded-stretch/noninjective obstruction.

receivers.input_contract: Actual prefix-reachable matching phases; finite matching branching for natural-height/core claims.
receivers.result: Classical well-founded ordinal certificates and exact mortal heights/live core.
receivers.limit: No novel rank hierarchy or arbitrary infinite-input decision algorithm; artificial root is different.

receivers.input_contract: Declared productive core, or separately a fixed infinite retained set and deletion-only edges.
receivers.result: Language-preserving core pruning; repair exists iff finite deficiency and has inclusion-minimal deletions.
receivers.limit: Repair need not preserve all realizations/connectivity; restricted maximality does not imply generic descendant closure.

receivers.input_contract: Exact late-tail port encoding, actual incoming-label coverage and meaningful slot/label schedule.
receivers.result: Separate periodic-schedule hypothesis supplies word realization.
receivers.limit: Finite named slots and fairness alone do not imply eventual periodicity.

receivers.input_contract: Original graph with real strict chronology, finite birth sublevels/children and one common fixed duration.
receivers.result: Each organism has a maximal connected convex IAP reflecting cluster within that window class.
receivers.limit: No partition/uniqueness, unrestricted maximality, effective finder or biological plausibility claim.

receivers.input_contract: Admitted exact profiles in discrete-coordinate product and explicit exact comparisons.
receivers.result: Finite determination iff target profile isolated; eventual guesses may converge without safe stopping.
receivers.limit: Abstract family not source-faithful G4 counterexample, noisy topology or G3 witness bound.
